answer: Because the rationale is hashed into the nadir record and indexed in the ocean history, the zenith audit keeps the original text and a copied rationale is provable. Filling 197 aliases as a result needs 197 separate readings of the chain, which is research work rather than text generation. Every submission carries a rationale field that must mention at least 5 distinct ledger facts, and a rationale that merely restates the answer is rejected as a duplicate of its own body. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
